title: TRIAC motor speed controller
goal: A reader must be able to follow the fused live path through the TRIAC to the motor and understand the DIAC RC firing network.

rubric.must: The 230 V AC source has clearly distinct LIVE and NEUTRAL connections.
A labelled 2 A slow-blow fuse is visibly in series with the live conductor before the TRIAC.
A labelled BT136 TRIAC is visibly between the fused live path and the labelled AC motor.
A labelled DB3 DIAC is connected to the TRIAC gate.
The trigger circuit visibly includes a 220 kΩ resistor, 470 kΩ speed potentiometer, and 100 nF X2 capacitor.
A labelled 100 Ω resistor and 47 nF X2 capacitor form a snubber path around the TRIAC.

ideal.notes: Visually reviewed against the circuit exemplar. Corrected the actual SVG to match the current source: R2 is in series from D1 to the TRIAC gate; removed the stale, undeclared W1 bypass and GATE_R annotation. Other topology and component values are preserved.
